help.cost: Typical cost: one explanation ≈ $0.01 · one fix ≈ $0.01–0.05 · reading and search 0 tokens
help.engine.notInstalled: AI engine: {engine} is not installed (reading and search keep working)
help.engine.notLoggedIn: AI engine: not signed in to {engine} — run claude /login in a terminal (reading and search keep working)
help.guide.accept.d: Answers arrive as cards in the margin, fixes as a diff. Accept each change in Review: it goes to your working tree, uncommitted. <kbd>⌘Z</kbd> undoes it.
help.guide.ask.d: Select a sentence for the toolbar, or on a paragraph press <kbd>e</kbd> explain · <kbd>f</kbd> fix · <kbd>c</kbd> comment. Typing a question into <kbd>⌘K</kbd> and choosing Ask the AI does the same. You see the estimate before anything is sent.
help.guide.ask.t: Select a sentence, ask the AI
help.guide.codeRead.d: The column on the right lists the doc sections that describe this range. Long files have an outline to jump through.
help.guide.inboxFilter.d: Filter by mine · working · failed · needs re-anchoring. Number keys switch.
help.guide.inboxOpen.d: <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> to choose, <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open. Ready jobs go straight to Review.
help.guide.inboxSend.d: <kbd>⇧F</kbd> sends the held comments to the AI in one round. Notes for people stay.
help.guide.mapGen.d: The static doc is readable now at 0 tokens. For the AI's prose, check cost and time on the card on the right, then Generate.
help.guide.mapOpen.d: <kbd>Enter</kbd> or a double click opens the doc section about the room. The contents and the 5-minute course start here too.
help.guide.mapRoom.d: A room is a cohesive piece of the code. Click it or use the arrow keys to see its role and main files. <kbd>=</kbd> <kbd>-</kbd> zoom.
help.guide.read.d: Change the depth with New · Standard · Expert above (<kbd>-</kbd> <kbd>=</kbd>). Point at a cite chip to see its code; <kbd>o</kbd> pins it beside the text.
help.guide.reviewAccept.d: <kbd>⌘⏎</kbd> accepts into your working tree, uncommitted. <kbd>⌘Z</kbd> puts it back.
help.guide.reviewPick.d: Move with <kbd>n</kbd> <kbd>⇧N</kbd> and mark each change ✓ or ✕. Doc update proposals are picked the same way.
help.guide.reviewSee.d: The panel shows the request, the automatic checks (gofmt, tests…) and the cost. The text on the left is the anchored paragraph.
help.guide.reviewSee.t: See the request and the checks
